beats.text: A football match. Play is about to stop for a minute — the players drink, the coach talks. The broadcast will not cut away.
Play stops. The first ad is a still image, laid over the live picture — the mechanism takes an image as happily as it takes video.
More of the screen, and the match never leaves it. The picture folds into a corner and the ad takes the L.
This is how it is done today: ten seconds with the match gone. It is still playing underneath — you just cannot see it. That is when the viewer leaves the room, and the ad plays to nobody.
And back. Fifty-eight seconds of advertising in one stoppage, and nobody was given a reason to look away.
